attributes.action: Tianne Olivia's Law: Strengthen Protections for Women and Girls
attributes.additional_details: Tianne Olivia’s Law is about making sure women are not left without meaningful protection when they disclose domestic abuse, recognising the devastating and often hidden impact of coercive control. It is also about what happens when a victim is no longer here to speak for herself. A woman’s voice, experiences and evidence should not disappear with her. Her death should not end the opportunity to learn from what happened to her and prevent another woman from suffering the same fate.
attributes.background: We want the Government to strengthen protections for women and girls experiencing domestic abuse, close gaps in the current law and support. Ensure victims can access safety and specialist support after disclosure, including where coercive control, strangulation or other risks are present.

rejection.details:
We find this petition to be unclear - no specific actions are requested. We do have other petitions open on domestic abuse support and protection, which you may wish to look at and possibly sign:

Make Domestic Abuse a specific offence with a minimum 2 year custodial sentence
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/771920

Make those convicted for domestic abuse ineligible for early release
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/769478

Require convicted domestic abuse offenders to be placed on a national register
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/772194
